correctness.rationale: Independent canonical enumeration of the 32 vertices of L(Q4) and their line-graph shortest paths produces exactly 13,896 simplices with face vector (32,336,1568,3672,4512,2848,832,96). The explicit 32-vertex toggle matching has 6,943 paired face-poset edges; all 66,304 oriented Hasse covers admit a complete 13,896-vertex topological ordering and hence have no directed cycle. The 10 unmatched cells have dimensions 0,3,5 (multiplicities 1,1,8). Forman discrete Morse CW model has no neighboring nonzero cell dimensions, so all cellular boundary maps vanish integrally, yielding H3=Z, H5=Z^8, no other reduced groups. Crucially no unsupported inference of a homotopy wedge is made.
risks: No claim about the 5-cell attaching maps is needed for homology; exact exhaustive enumeration is valid for this fixed finite 32-point metric, not general n.
